jobs.title: CRM and Business Systems Analyst
jobs.description: CRM Dynamics and Business Systems Analyst responsible for administration, optimization, and strategic support of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM and connected business platforms. Serve as primary business owner and administrator for Dynamics 365 CRM including configuration, workflows and automation, security roles, data structures, integrations, monitoring, troubleshooting, and release management. Manage contact and relationship processes, duplicate detection and merge procedures, cross-system synchronization, data integrity and governance. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Analytics, and Information Technology; translate business requirements into technical specifications and support system enhancements, integrations, upgrades, testing, deployment, documentation, training, and user adoption. Develop and maintain CRM views, dashboards, and reports and coordinate Power BI outputs. Establish data quality, security, access controls, backup, retention, and recovery practices. Identify opportunities for process improvement, continuous improvement, workflow optimization, automation, and system enhancements. Minimum three years administering, supporting, and managing Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM. Demonstrated CRM configuration, workflows and automation, security, data management, and stakeholder collaboration. Preferred familiarity with Microsoft Dataverse, Power BI, regulated industries, marketing automation, data governance, and continuous improvement.
